coordinates.object_orientation: Broad shell plane in XY, flattened basal surface at z=0, low relief +Z. Put expanded outer terminal sector toward front camera -Y; top +Z shows same coil silhouette. No diagnostic bottom anatomy invented.

concept.reason: Actual same-specimen visual and published diameter support bounded fossil-shell interpretation; concept would add no evidence.

scope: Single low broad asymmetric coiled fossil shell, visually anchored to PRI76290. Not a specimen scan, no living animal, no copied mesh or texture.

scale.basis: PRI gives approximate shell diameter11cm. Height30mm is a conservative modelling proportion, NOT measured museum height.
scale.uncertainty: Reference inspected is oblique/top preview, not underside. Flat lower face is group-level form support; exact bottom and aperture preservation are unverified and kept simple.

required_features: Low broad asymmetric coiled shell, not an upright turret, perfect planar ammonite, doughnut or simple disc.
Match actual PRI76290 preview: compact center and roughly three expanding visible turns; dominant broad outer whorl, subtle sutural grooves and irregular weathered perimeter.
Maintain nearly flat lower face and low upper relief. Underside is a conservative interpretation, not claimed observed surface.

Outer terminal sector must remain broader/heavier than inner coil, with uneven fossil-like rim. Do not invent a pristine flared open tube or deep black aperture: reference terminal preservation is uncertain.
Use restrained limestone gray/tan original flat colors and light asymmetry; do not turn color/noise into substitute for geometric whorl structure.
Read clearly in four standard views, with low profile in front/side and expanding coil in top.
forbidden: Soft body, tentacles or operculum invented from modern snails
Symmetric ammonite ribs/chambers or perfect torus
Ground, decorative base, label in GLB
